usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all network interfaces configured on a PDM node, including their type (eth, bridge, bond, vlan, alias), IP assignments, and active/autostart state. The caller must hold the System.Audit privilege on the node's network path. Results reflect the on-disk configuration (/etc/network/interfaces) and include a digest for optimistic-lock checks when making subsequent write calls.

examples.summary: List all network interfaces on node 'pve1'

tips: The 'active' field reflects the live kernel state (interface UP); 'autostart' reflects whether it is set to come up at boot — these can differ if an interface was manually downed or is pending a reboot after config changes.
Bridge interfaces include a 'bridge_ports' array listing their member NICs; bond interfaces expose their member NICs via 'slaves' and the bonding mode via 'bond_mode'.
The response includes a config digest. Pass this digest to write operations (e.g., PUT /nodes/{node}/network/{iface}) to avoid overwriting concurrent changes.
Use 'localhost' as the node value when the PDM API host is itself the target node.
